purpose: Reusable component contract for local interactive training modules.

components.label: Lesson
components.purpose: Teach a compact concept before practice.
components.reuse_notes: Keep bodies concise and tie every lesson to a later interaction.

components.label: Multiple Choice
components.purpose: Check recognition of the safest or most accurate path.
components.reuse_notes: Use for command selection, source classification, and unsafe-claim spotting.

components.label: Checklist
components.purpose: Train minimum proof, approval, or handoff fields.
validation: all checklist items must be selected for a pass
components.reuse_notes: Use when a task has non-negotiable completeness fields.

components.label: Scenario
components.purpose: Practice written operator judgment under uncertainty.
components.reuse_notes: Use for stale proof, conflict, warning-grade, and boundary-repair cases.

components.label: Reflection
validation: rubric names safe use and blocked use
components.reuse_notes: Use as the final practice item for each module.

components.label: Boundary Acknowledgement
components.purpose: Force explicit recognition of authority limits.
components.reuse_notes: Every module that touches action authority should include one.

components.label: Local xAPI Events
components.purpose: Record local started, answered, completed, passed, failed, and boundary review events.
components.reuse_notes: Default storage is browser-local; loopback ledger is optional and local-only.

components.label: SCORM Package
components.purpose: Package the module for later LMS smoke/import testing.
components.reuse_notes: External LMS import remains owner-gated; local mock-LMS smoke is the proof path.

components.label: Browser QA
components.purpose: Prove desktop/mobile rendering, accessibility, console, and overflow behavior.
components.reuse_notes: Run after each new module or runtime change.
